summary: Carded out of the bench session that evaluated LanPaint. Proven working on Klein 4B distilled and 9B with multi-ref conditioning intact. Orthogonal to crop-and-stitch, not a replacement: LanPaint fixes WHAT the sampler does inside the region, crop-and-stitch fixes WHAT RESOLUTION it runs at, and the two compose. Qwen edit is a one-node swap (plain KSampler); Klein needs restructuring because it samples via SamplerCustomAdvanced + Flux2Scheduler + SplitSigmasDenoise.
